questions.questionText: The number of bit strings of length 10 that contain either five consecutive 0's or five consecutive 1's is:

explanation.summary: Total bit strings of length 10 is $2^{10} = 1024$. By inclusion-exclusion on consecutive runs of five 0s or five 1s, the number of such bit strings is 222.

stepByStep.title: Official Solution

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.questionText: If $0 < x < \pi$ and $\cos x + \sin x = 1/2$, then the value of $\tan x$ is:

explanation.summary: Squaring gives $1 + \sin 2x = 1/4 \implies \sin 2x = -3/4$. Then $\frac{2\tan x}{1+\tan^2 x} = -3/4 \implies 3\tan^2 x + 8\tan x + 3 = 0 \implies \tan x = \frac{-8 \pm \sqrt{64-36}}{6} = \frac{-4 \pm \sqrt{7}}{3}$.

stepByStep.title: Official Solution
stepByStep.content: Squaring gives $1 + \sin 2x = 1/4 \implies \sin 2x = -3/4$. Then $\frac{2\tan x}{1+\tan^2 x} = -3/4 \implies 3\tan^2 x + 8\tan x + 3 = 0 \implies \tan x = \frac{-8 \pm \sqrt{64-36}}{6} = \frac{-4 \pm \sqrt{7}}{3}$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.questionText: If $\int e^x (f(x) - f'(x)) dx = \phi(x)$, then the value of $\int e^x f(x) dx$ is:

explanation.summary: $\int e^x f'(x)dx = e^x f(x) - \int e^x f(x)dx$. Substituting: $\phi(x) = 2\int e^x f(x)dx - e^x f(x) \implies \int e^x f(x)dx = \frac{1}{2}[\phi(x) + e^x f(x)]$.

stepByStep.title: Official Solution
stepByStep.content: $\int e^x f'(x)dx = e^x f(x) - \int e^x f(x)dx$. Substituting: $\phi(x) = 2\int e^x f(x)dx - e^x f(x) \implies \int e^x f(x)dx = \frac{1}{2}[\phi(x) + e^x f(x)]$.

questions.questionText: The value of $k$ for which the equation $(k-2)x^2 + 8x + k + 4 = 0$ has both real, distinct and negative roots is:

explanation.summary: Discriminant $D = 64 - 4(k-2)(k+4) > 0 \implies (k+6)(k-4) < 0 \implies -6 < k < 4$. For negative roots: sum of roots $= -\frac{8}{k-2} < 0 \implies k - 2 > 0 \implies k > 2$. Product $= \frac{k+4}{k-2} > 0$. Thus $2 < k < 4$. The integer value is $k = 3$.

questions.questionText: If $(2, 1), (-1, -2), (3, 3)$ are the midpoints of the sides BC, CA, AB of $\Delta ABC$, then the equation of line BC is:

explanation.summary: Line BC is parallel to the line joining midpoints CA $(-1, -2)$ and AB $(3, 3)$. Slope $m = \frac{3 - (-2)}{3 - (-1)} = 5/4$. BC passes through $(2, 1)$: $y - 1 = \frac{5}{4}(x - 2) \implies 4y - 4 = 5x - 10 \implies 5x - 4y - 6 = 0$.

stepByStep.title: Official Solution

questions.questionText: Let $\vec{a} = \hat{i} + \hat{j} + \hat{k}, \vec{b} = \hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k}, \vec{c} = \hat{i} - \hat{j} - \hat{k}$. A vector $\vec{v}$ in the plane of $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{b}$ whose projection on $\vec{c}$ is $1/\sqrt{3}$ is:

explanation.summary: Let $\vec{v} = \lambda\vec{a} + \mu\vec{b} = (\lambda+\mu)\hat{i} + (\lambda-\mu)\hat{j} + (\lambda+\mu)\hat{k}$. $\vec{v}\cdot\vec{c} / \sqrt{3} = 1/\sqrt{3} \implies \lambda + \mu - (\lambda - \mu) - (\lambda + \mu) = 1 \implies \mu - \lambda = 1$. For $\lambda = 1, \mu = 2$, $\vec{v} = 3\hat{i} - \hat{j} + 3\hat{k}$.

stepByStep.title: Official Solution
stepByStep.content: Let $\vec{v} = \lambda\vec{a} + \mu\vec{b} = (\lambda+\mu)\hat{i} + (\lambda-\mu)\hat{j} + (\lambda+\mu)\hat{k}$. $\vec{v}\cdot\vec{c} / \sqrt{3} = 1/\sqrt{3} \implies \lambda + \mu - (\lambda - \mu) - (\lambda + \mu) = 1 \implies \mu - \lambda = 1$. For $\lambda = 1, \mu = 2$, $\vec{v} = 3\hat{i} - \hat{j} + 3\hat{k}$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.questionText: The value of $\int_{-\pi/3}^{\pi/3} \frac{x\sin x}{\cos^2 x} dx$ is:

explanation.summary: Integrand is even function: $2\int_0^{\pi/3} x\tan x\sec x dx = 2[x\sec x - \log|\sec x+\tan x|]_0^{\pi/3} = 2(\frac{2\pi}{3} - \log(2+\sqrt{3})) = \frac{4\pi}{3} - 2\log\tan\frac{5\pi}{12}$.

stepByStep.title: Official Solution
stepByStep.content: Integrand is even function: $2\int_0^{\pi/3} x\tan x\sec x dx = 2[x\sec x - \log|\sec x+\tan x|]_0^{\pi/3} = 2(\frac{2\pi}{3} - \log(2+\sqrt{3})) = \frac{4\pi}{3} - 2\log\tan\frac{5\pi}{12}$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.questionText: The foci of the ellipse $\frac{x^2}{16} + \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1$ and the hyperbola $\frac{x^2}{144} - \frac{y^2}{81} = \frac{1}{25}$ coincide. The value of $b^2$ is:

explanation.summary: Foci of hyperbola: $ae = \sqrt{144/25 + 81/25} = 3$. For ellipse: $a^2 - b^2 = 3^2 = 9 \implies 16 - b^2 = 9 \implies b^2 = 7$.

stepByStep.title: Official Solution
stepByStep.content: Foci of hyperbola: $ae = \sqrt{144/25 + 81/25} = 3$. For ellipse: $a^2 - b^2 = 3^2 = 9 \implies 16 - b^2 = 9 \implies b^2 = 7$.

explanation.summary: $\sin(A+B+C) = \sin\pi = 0$. $\cos(A+B) = \cos(\pi-C) = -\cos C$. The matrix is skew-symmetric of order 3, so its determinant is identically 0.

stepByStep.title: Official Solution
stepByStep.content: $\sin(A+B+C) = \sin\pi = 0$. $\cos(A+B) = \cos(\pi-C) = -\cos C$. The matrix is skew-symmetric of order 3, so its determinant is identically 0.

questions.questionText: If the mean deviation of the numbers $1, 1+d, 1+2d, \dots, 1+100d$ from their mean is 255, then the value of $d$ is:

explanation.summary: Mean $\bar{x} = 1 + 50d$. Mean deviation $= \frac{2d}{101}\sum_{k=1}^{50} k = \frac{2d(50 \times 51)}{2 \times 101} = \frac{2550 d}{101} = 255 \implies d = 10.1$.

stepByStep.title: Official Solution
stepByStep.content: Mean $\bar{x} = 1 + 50d$. Mean deviation $= \frac{2d}{101}\sum_{k=1}^{50} k = \frac{2d(50 \times 51)}{2 \times 101} = \frac{2550 d}{101} = 255 \implies d = 10.1$.

explanation.summary: Since $\sin^{20}\theta \le \sin^2\theta$ and $\cos^{48}\theta \le \cos^2\theta$, $P \le \sin^2\theta + \cos^2\theta = 1$. Since sine and cosine cannot be simultaneously zero, $0 < P \le 1$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.questionText: If $A = \begin{bmatrix} a & b & c \\ b & c & a \\ c & a & b \end{bmatrix}$ with $abc = 1$ and $A^T A = I$, then which holds true?

explanation.summary: $A^T A = I \implies \det(A)^2 = 1 \implies \det(A) = \pm 1$. Since $\det(A) = -(a^3+b^3+c^3 - 3abc) = -1 \implies a^3+b^3+c^3 - 3(1) = 1 \implies a^3+b^3+c^3 = 4$.

stepByStep.title: Official Solution
stepByStep.content: $A^T A = I \implies \det(A)^2 = 1 \implies \det(A) = \pm 1$. Since $\det(A) = -(a^3+b^3+c^3 - 3abc) = -1 \implies a^3+b^3+c^3 - 3(1) = 1 \implies a^3+b^3+c^3 = 4$.

explanation.summary: $x = a(1 - 2\sin^2 t) = a - 2a(y^2 / 8a^2) = a - y^2 / (4a) \implies y^2 = -4a(x - a)$. Tangent line of slope $m$: $y = mx - a(m + 1/m)$.

stepByStep.title: Official Solution

explanation.summary: Chord through vertex $(0,0)$ to $(t^2, 2t)$ has midpoint $(h, k) = (t^2/2, t) \implies t = k, h = k^2/2 \implies k^2 = 2h$, i.e. $y^2 = 2x$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.questionText: $\lim_{x \to a} \frac{\sqrt{a+2x} - \sqrt{3x}}{\sqrt{3a+x} - 2\sqrt{x}}$ is:

explanation.summary: By L'Hopital rule: $\frac{\frac{2}{2\sqrt{a+2x}} - \frac{3}{2\sqrt{3x}}}{\frac{1}{2\sqrt{3a+x}} - \frac{2}{2\sqrt{x}}} \to \frac{1/\sqrt{3a} - \sqrt{3}/(2\sqrt{a})}{1/(4\sqrt{a}) - 1/\sqrt{a}} = \frac{-1/(2\sqrt{3a})}{-3/(4\sqrt{a})} = \frac{2}{3\sqrt{3}}$.

stepByStep.title: Official Solution
stepByStep.content: By L'Hopital rule: $\frac{\frac{2}{2\sqrt{a+2x}} - \frac{3}{2\sqrt{3x}}}{\frac{1}{2\sqrt{3a+x}} - \frac{2}{2\sqrt{x}}} \to \frac{1/\sqrt{3a} - \sqrt{3}/(2\sqrt{a})}{1/(4\sqrt{a}) - 1/\sqrt{a}} = \frac{-1/(2\sqrt{3a})}{-3/(4\sqrt{a})} = \frac{2}{3\sqrt{3}}$.

explanation.summary: Rationalizing $\frac{1}{(n+1)\sqrt{n} + n\sqrt{n+1}} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{n}} - \frac{1}{\sqrt{n+1}}$. Telescoping sum $= 1 - \frac{1}{\sqrt{25}} = 1 - 1/5 = 4/5$.

stepByStep.title: Official Solution
